q:
Consider the following statements on the contributions of Pandit Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar:
I. His great contribution was for the upliftment of women in India.
II. He organized a powerful movement for the enactment of Widow Remarriage Act.
III. To propagate his social ideas, he published Sambad Kaumudi, a Bengali weekly newspaper.
Which of the above statements are correct?
explanation: I and II are correct: Vidyasagar worked for women and led the movement for the 1856 Act. III is wrong, because Sambad Kaumudi (1821) was Rammohan Roy's paper.

notes.text: - **Widow remarriage:** the reformer who worked successfully to **legalise widow remarriage**; he **cited the ancient (Vedic) texts** (Parashara) to show widows could remarry → **Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act (Act XV of 1856)**, drafted under **Dalhousie**, **passed under Lord Canning** (July 1856).

- **Women's education:** in 1850 Bethune made him **Secretary of the Hindu Female School**, later the **Bethune School** (founded **1849** by **J.E.D. Bethune**, with Dakshinaranjan Mukherjee); he ran about **35 girls' schools**.
- **Not his:** **Sambad Kaumudi** (1821) and **Mirat-ul-Akhbar** (1822) were **Rammohan Roy**'s; the 1829 sati ban was Roy's campaign under **Bentinck** (not Keshab Chandra Sen).

q: ____ was a great Bengali polymath, Sanskrit pandit, educator, social reformer and will always be remembered gratefully by his countrymen for his contribution to the upliftment of India's down-trodden women.
explanation: Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar, the Bengali Sanskrit scholar, educator and reformer, is remembered for widow remarriage and women's education.

notes.text: - **Widow remarriage:** the reformer who worked successfully to **legalise widow remarriage**; he **cited the ancient (Vedic) texts** (Parashara) to show widows could remarry → **Hindu Widows' Remarriage Act (Act XV of 1856)**, drafted under **Dalhousie**, **passed under Lord Canning** (July 1856).
- **Principal of the Sanskrit College, Calcutta** (1851) – opened it to non-Brahmins; title "**Vidyasagar**" (Ocean of Learning) for his Sanskrit learning.

q: As per the Age of Consent Act, 1891, consummation (irrespective of marriage) was forbidden for girls below this age?

q: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Lex Loci Act of 1850?
options: It prohibited child marriage below the age of
It extended the prohibition of Sati all across British India
It provided the right to inherit ancestral property to Hindu converts to Christianity
It granted the legal recognition to widow marriages. SECTION B Geography
key_text: It provided the right to inherit ancestral property to Hindu converts to Christianity
explanation: The Lex Loci (Caste Disabilities Removal) Act of 1850 let a Hindu convert still inherit ancestral property. It did not deal with child marriage, sati or widow remarriage.
